title: Limitation on liability.
bodyText: The University of Hawaii, department of education, and the State of Hawaii shall not be held liable for the sums deferred or the results of any investment product.
bodyHtml: §303-3.5  Limitation on liability.  The University of Hawaii, department of education, and the State of Hawaii shall not be held liable for the sums deferred or the results of any investment product. [L 1999, c 123, §1; am L 2001, c 186, §3]
